title: Pentanuclear Heterometallic {Ni2Ln3} (Ln = Gd, Dy, Tb, Ho) Assemblies. Single-Molecule Magnet Behavior and Multistep Relaxation in the Dysprosium Derivative

synthesis.procedure: General protocol for 1–4: LH4 (0.052 g, 0.15 mmol) was dissolved in methanol (20 mL). LnCl3·6H2O (0.037 g, 0.10 mmol) and triethylamine (0.06 mL, 0.45 mmol) were added and the mixture was stirred for 1 h. NiCl2·4H2O (0.023 g, 0.10 mmol) was then added and stirring continued for a further 3 h at room temperature to afford a clear red solution. The solution was evaporated in vacuo (bath temperature not exceeding 40 °C) to a powder that was washed with diethyl ether. X-ray quality crystals of 1–4 were grown by vapor diffusion of diethyl ether into a methanol/chloroform (1:1 v/v) solution of the corresponding complex.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirred solution; vacuum evaporation; vapor diffusion crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: evaporated in vacuo to a powder, washed with diethyl ether; crystals grown by vapor diffusion of diethyl ether into methanol/chloroform (1:1 v/v)

properties.summary: Compound 1 has a high/ferromagnetic effective ground state (Seff,T = 15/2) and SMM behavior with two thermally activated relaxation regimes plus low-T quantum tunneling. Open hysteresis is observed up to TB ≈ 3 K for sweep rates faster than 50 mT/s. Square-planar Ni(II) is treated as diamagnetic.

measurements.name: χT (room-temperature value)
measurements.conditions: dc susceptibility; compared with expected 40.5 cm3 K mol-1 for 3 Dy(III)

measurements.name: Ueff (high-T Arrhenius)
measurements.conditions: ac susceptibility; thermally activated regime ~10–17 K; τ0 = 5.9e-7 s

measurements.name: τ0 (high-T)
measurements.conditions: Arrhenius fit of ac data, high-T process

measurements.name: Ueff (low-T Arrhenius)
measurements.conditions: ac susceptibility; second thermally activated process below 7 K; τ0 = 2.3e-8 s

measurements.name: τ0 (low-T)
measurements.conditions: Arrhenius fit of ac data, low-T thermally activated process

measurements.name: Cole–Cole α
measurements.conditions: generalized Debye analysis of frequency-dependent ac data

measurements.name: tunnel rate
measurements.conditions: estimated from nearly T-independent low-T ac relaxation

measurements.name: blocking temperature TB
measurements.conditions: Hall-probe magnetization of a single crystal

measurements.name: hysteresis opening sweep-rate threshold
measurements.conditions: open hysteresis for faster sweeps; loops closed around zero field at slow rates; 300 mK sweep-rate series
